verse.verse_1: When the heaven is split asunder,
verse.verse_3: when the seas are made to burst forth,
verse.verse_4: and when graves are laid open,
verse.verse_5: everyone shall know all his deeds, both the earlier and the later.
verse.verse_6: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord
verse.verse_7: Who created you, shaped you, and made you well-proportioned,
verse.verse_8: and set you in whatever form He pleased?
verse.verse_9: No indeed; (the fact is that) you deny the Reckoning, declaring it a lie;
verse.verse_10: you do so the while there are watchers over you;
verse.verse_13: Surely the virtuous shall be in Bliss,
verse.verse_14: and the wicked shall be in the Blazing Fire.
verse.verse_15: They shall enter it on the Day of Recompense
verse.verse_16: and then shall never come out of it.
verse.verse_17: What do you know what the Day of Recompense is?
verse.verse_18: Again, what do you know what the Day of Recompense is?
verse.verse_19: It is the Day when no one shall have the power to do anything for another, and all command shall be Allah's.
